svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Back-end: Python, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, TypeScript; Integração: REST, webhooks, Pub/Sub, Redis Streams, OAuth2, MCP; Front-end: Angular, React, Next.js, Vue.js, Tailwind, design system; IA: LangGraph, Google ADK, Vertex AI, Gemini, Claude, RAG, avaliação de LLM; Dados: PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, BigQuery, Firestore; Entrega: GCP, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, TDD
